flows.title: Create a content type
steps: In the Contentful web app, go to the Content model tab.
In the Name field, enter a name for the content type. An API identifier is generated from the name.
Optionally, enter a description in the Description field.
Click + Add field to add the first field to the new content type, and repeat to add more fields one by one.
Click Save to apply the changes to the content type.

flows.title: Add a new entry
steps: In the Contentful web app, go to the Content tab.
Click Add entry and select the content type for the entry from the drop-down.
The entry editor opens. Add your content to each field as needed; a text editor field can be formatted with Rich Text or Markdown.

flows.title: Schedule an entry to be published or unpublished
steps: In the Contentful web app, go to the Content tab and select the entry you want to edit, or create a new entry.
Make the edits you want to publish.
In the entry editor, click the drop-down arrow on the Publish button and select Set schedule.
In the Set Schedule modal, choose whether to publish or unpublish the entry, and pick the date, time and timezone. The timezone defaults to your computer's.
Click Set Schedule. The scheduled action appears in the entry sidebar.
